header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation is received. This
body: petition was filed in the year 2023 and was lastly fixed in Court on 09.08.2023. Perusal of the petition reflects that auction held in 2023 was challenged and the validity of that auction has now expired. Accordingly, the instant petition being infructuous stands disposed of.
